item.title: [翻译] TLDR AI: Claude发现Firefox漏洞，AI市场与代码安全新进展
item.description:
标签: #AI安全 #Claude生态 #代码生成 #AI工具

摘要: Claude Opus 4.6在两周内发现Firefox浏览器超百个漏洞（含14个高危），同时Anthropic推出Claude Marketplace企业应用商店，OpenAI也发布了Codex Security代码安全分析工具。

原标题: Claude finds Firefox bugs 🐛, Claude Marketplace 🤝, Codex Security 🤖

TLDR AI 2026-03-09

Claude finds Firefox bugs 🐛, Claude Marketplace 🤝, Codex Security 🤖

Most Product Teams Are Failing at AI Adoption. This Research Explains Why (Sponsor)

Miro 委托 Forrester Consulting 和 Harvard Business Review Analytic Services 开展了这项研究。他们的联合研究调查了全球产品负责人，以找出最大的阻碍因素以及真正有效的策略。

Product leaders are under pressure to ship AI-powered features faster. But despite the rush, most organizations still struggle to unlock AI's full potential. So what's going wrong? Miro commissioned Forrester Consulting and Harvard Business Review Analytic Services to find out. Their joint research surveyed product leaders worldwide to pinpoint the biggest roadblocks — and the strategies that are actually working. Read it for:
  • New insights from global product leaders
  • Data on the biggest prod roadblocks
  • How leaders are using AI to actually boost productivity
Get the free ebook

产品负责人面临着更快交付 AI 驱动功能（AI-powered features）的压力。但尽管赶工匆忙，大多数组织仍在努力释放 AI 的全部潜力。那么问题出在哪里？ 阅读本报告可获取：

  • 来自全球产品负责人的新见解
  • 关于最大产品障碍的数据
  • 领导者如何利用 AI 真正提升生产力
获取免费电子书

Meta silently launches Vibes AI editor (2 minute read)

Meta 悄然推出 Vibes AI 编辑器（2 分钟阅读）

Meta silently launched the Vibes AI editor, transforming it from a feature in Meta AI to a standalone creation studio similar to Google Flow. The editor supports project creation, image and video generation, timeline editing, and other production tools. While the tooling is robust, output quality needs improvement.

Meta 悄然推出了 Vibes AI 编辑器，将其从 Meta AI 中的一项功能转变为一个独立的创作工作室，类似于 Google Flow。该编辑器支持项目创建、图像和视频生成、时间线编辑以及其他制作工具。虽然工具功能强大，但输出质量有待提升。

Anthropic's AI Hacked the Firefox Browser. It Found a Lot of Bugs (3 minute read)

Anthropic 的 AI 破解了 Firefox 浏览器，发现了大量漏洞（3 分钟阅读）

Claude Opus 4.6 found more high-severity bugs in Firefox over a two-week period than the rest of the world typically reports in two months. The model discovered more than 100 bugs in total, 14 that were tagged as high severity. The model was asked to write code to exploit the bugs, but it turns out the model is much better at finding bugs than exploiting them. The exploits that Claude wrote would have been stopped in the real world by Firefox's other security mechanisms.

Claude Opus 4.6 在两周内在 Firefox 浏览器中发现的高严重性漏洞数量，超过了全球其他地区通常两个月报告的总和。该模型共发现 100 多个漏洞，其中 14 个被标记为高严重性。研究人员要求模型编写代码来利用这些漏洞，但结果表明，该模型更擅长发现漏洞而非利用漏洞。Claude 编写的攻击代码在现实世界中会被 Firefox 的其他安全机制拦截。

Claude Marketplace (1 minute read)

Claude 应用市场（1 分钟阅读）

The Claude Marketplace allows organizations to use some of their existing Anthropic commitment to purchase Claude-powered tools. Partner purchases will count against a portion of an organization's existing Anthropic commitment. Anthropic will manage all invoicing for partner spend. The marketplace is launching with GitLab, Harvey, Lovable, Replit, Rogo, and Snowflake, and Anthropic is looking for more companies to work with.

Claude Marketplace（Claude 应用市场）允许组织使用其对 Anthropic 的部分现有承诺额度购买 Claude 驱动的工具。合作伙伴的购买将计入组织现有 Anthropic 承诺额度的一部分。Anthropic 将管理合作伙伴支出的所有发票。该市场首发合作伙伴包括 GitLab、Harvey、Lovable、Replit、Rogo 和 Snowflake，Anthropic 正在寻找更多公司合作。

Reasoning boosts search relevance 15-30% (9 minute read)

推理能力将搜索相关性提升 15-30%（9 分钟阅读）

Reasoning agents work best with simple search tools. Developers should use simple, easy-to-understand, and transparent search systems like grep or basic keyword search. Agents can sift through results, learn, and retry with what they've learned. Asking an agent to explain the intent behind a query helps the agent reason about how to best satisfy the request by forcing it to think about what the user wants.

推理智能体（Reasoning agents）与简单的搜索工具配合效果最佳。开发者应使用简单、易懂且透明的搜索系统，如 grep 或基础关键词搜索。智能体可以筛选结果、学习并根据所学内容重试。要求智能体解释查询背后的意图，有助于其通过强制思考用户需求来推理如何最好地满足请求。

The emerging role of SRAM-centric chips in AI inference (4 minute read)

SRAM 中心芯片在 AI 推理中的新兴角色（4 分钟阅读）

SRAM-centric chips, like those from Cerebras and Groq, are gaining traction due to their advantages in AI inference workloads, particularly in minimizing latency and increasing throughput compared to traditional GPUs. This shift is driven by the demand for near-compute memory architectures, which offer faster data access than far-compute approaches like DRAM. The trade-off lies in balancing memory bandwidth and compute capacity, leading to new disaggregated hardware strategies that optimize both prefill and decode phases of AI tasks across varied hardware platforms.

SRAM 中心芯片（SRAM-centric chips），如 Cerebras 和 Groq 的产品，正因其在 AI 推理工作负载中的优势而获得关注，特别是在与传统 GPU 相比最小化延迟和增加吞吐量方面。这一转变是由近计算内存架构（near-compute memory architectures）的需求驱动的，后者比 DRAM 等远计算方案提供更快的数据访问。权衡在于平衡内存带宽和计算容量，从而催生了新的分解式硬件策略，以优化跨不同硬件平台的 AI 任务的预填充（prefill）和解码（decode）阶段。

Your LLM Doesn't Write Correct Code. It Writes Plausible Code. (8 minute read)

你的 LLM 不写正确的代码，它写的是看似合理的代码（8 分钟阅读）

A benchmarked LLM-generated Rust rewrite of SQLite ran 20,171x slower on primary key lookups because the query planner never checked the is_ipk flag, sending every WHERE clause through a full table scan instead of a B-tree search. The same author's disk cleanup daemon came in at 82,000 lines with a Bayesian scoring engine and PID controller to solve a problem that a one-line cron job already handles. The root failure is structural: LLMs optimize for plausible output matching the user's intent, and METR's RCT with 16 experienced open-source developers confirmed the problem scales, finding AI users were 19% slower while believing they were 20% faster. 👨‍💻

一个经基准测试的、由 LLM（大语言模型）生成的 SQLite Rust 重写版本，在主键查找上慢了 20,171 倍，因为查询规划器从未检查 is_ipk 标志，导致每个 WHERE 子句都通过全表扫描而非 B 树搜索执行。同一位作者的磁盘清理守护进程写了 82,000 行代码，使用贝叶斯评分引擎和 PID 控制器来解决一个单行 cron 作业就能处理的问题。根本缺陷是结构性的：LLM 针对匹配用户意图的看似合理的输出进行优化，而 METR（Model Evaluation and Threat Research）的随机对照试验（RCT）与 16 位经验丰富的开源开发人员证实了这一问题会扩大规模，发现 AI 用户实际慢了 19%，却自以为快了 20%。 👨‍💻

Engineering & Research

We Benchmarked Five MCP Server Architectures. The Accuracy Gap Was 25%. (Sponsor)

工程与研究

我们对五种 MCP 服务器架构进行了基准测试，准确率差距达 25%（赞助商）

378 prompts across CRM, ERP, project management, and data warehouse systems. Most MCP servers returned incorrect results 15–42% of the time. hit 98.5%. The variable wasn't the model — it was the connectivity layer between prompt and data source.

在 CRM（客户关系管理）、ERP（企业资源规划）、项目管理和数据仓库系统上进行了 378 个提示词测试。大多数 MCP 服务器（Model Context Protocol）的错误率达 15-42%。 达到 98.5%。变量不是模型本身，而是提示词与数据源之间的连接层。

Codex Security Research Preview (8 minute read)

Codex 安全研究预览（8 分钟阅读）

OpenAI Codex Security is an application security agent designed to analyze repositories, identify high‑impact vulnerabilities, and suggest fixes.

OpenAI Codex Security 是一个应用安全智能体（application security agent），旨在分析代码仓库、识别高影响力漏洞并提出修复建议。

Karpathy's AutoResearch (GitHub Repo)

Karpathy 的 AutoResearch（GitHub 仓库）

Andrej Karpathy open-sourced autoresearch, a project for running AI-driven research loops on a small single-GPU LLM training setup. It lets agents modify code and guidance files, run short training experiments, evaluate results, and iteratively keep improvements overnight.

Andrej Karpathy 开源了 autoresearch 项目，用于在小型单 GPU LLM 训练设置上运行 AI 驱动的研究循环。它允许智能体修改代码和指导文件、运行短训练实验、评估结果，并在一夜间迭代保持改进。

Google PM open-sources Always On Memory Agent, ditching vector databases for LLM-driven persistent memory (8 minute read)

Google PM 开源 Always On Memory Agent，放弃向量数据库转向 LLM 驱动的持久内存（8 分钟阅读）

The Always On Memory Agent is an agent system that ingests information continuously, consolidates it in the background, and then retrieves it later without relying on a conventional vector database. It is available on the official Google Cloud Platform GitHub page under a permissive MIT License that allows for commercial usage. Enterprise AI teams are moving beyond single-turn assistants into systems expected to remember preferences, preserve project context, and operate across longer horizons. The Always On Memory Agent offers a concrete starting point for that next layer of infrastructure.

Always On Memory Agent（持续在线记忆智能体）是一个持续摄取信息、在后台整合、随后检索而不依赖传统 向量数据库（vector database）的智能体系统。它可在 Google Cloud Platform 官方 GitHub 页面获取，采用允许商业用途的宽松 MIT 许可证（MIT License）。企业 AI 团队正从单轮对话助手转向能够记住偏好、保留项目上下文并在更长周期内运行的系统。Always On Memory Agent 为下一代基础设施提供了具体的起点。

掌握 Midjourney：如何无需复杂提示词即可创建一致且精美的品牌视觉

Jamey Gannon is an AI creative director who specializes in creating consistent, beautiful brand imagery using AI tools. In this episode, Jamey demonstrates her streamlined workflow for generating cohesive brand assets using Midjourney, Nano Banana, and other AI image tools. She walks through her process of creating mood boards, using style references, developing personalization codes, and strategically iterating to achieve a consistent aesthetic. Rather than relying on complex prompts, Jamey shows how visual references and strategic shortcuts can produce better results with less effort.

Jamey Gannon 是一位专注于使用 AI 工具创建一致且精美品牌视觉的 AI 创意总监（AI creative director）。在本期节目中，Jamey 展示了她使用 Midjourney、Nano Banana 及其他 AI 图像工具生成统一品牌资产的精简工作流程。她详细介绍了创建情绪板（mood boards）、使用风格参考（style references）、开发个性化代码（personalization codes）以及通过策略性迭代实现一致美学风格的过程。Jamey 展示了如何通过视觉参考和策略性捷径，而非依赖复杂的提示词（prompts），用更少的精力获得更好的结果。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 终究不是无聊的技术
item.description:
标签: #大模型 #编程 #技术选型 #智能体

摘要: 作者发现，最新的编码代理模型凭借长上下文和模式学习能力，已能够很好地掌握训练数据之外的新工具，打破了人们对其只会推荐主流技术（如Python、JavaScript）并强化"选择无聊技术"趋势的担忧。

原标题: Perhaps not Boring Technology after all

Perhaps not Boring Technology after all / 或许终究并非"乏味技术"

A recurring concern I've seen regarding LLMs for programming is that they will push our technology choices towards the tools that are best represented in their training data, making it harder for new, better tools to break through the noise.

我在使用LLMs（大语言模型，Large Language Models）进行编程时注意到一个反复出现的担忧：它们会将我们的技术选择推向那些在训练数据（training data）中表现最佳的工具，使得新的、更好的工具更难突破重围。

This was certainly the case a couple of years ago, when asking models for help with Python or JavaScript appeared to give much better results than questions about less widely used languages.

几年前的情况确实如此，当时向模型寻求Python或JavaScript方面的帮助，似乎比询问使用范围较小的语言能获得好得多的结果。

With the latest models running in good coding agent harnesses I'm not sure this continues to hold up.

随着最新模型在优秀的coding agent（编程智能体/编码代理）框架中运行，我不确定这种情况是否仍然成立。

I'm seeing excellent results with my brand new tools where I start by prompting "use uvx showboat --help / rodney --help / chartroom --help to learn about these tools" - the context length of these new models is long enough that they can consume quite a lot of documentation before they start working on a problem.

我在使用全新工具时看到了出色的效果，我会先提示："使用uvx showboat --help / rodney --help / chartroom --help来了解这些工具"——这些新模型的context length（上下文长度）足够长，使得它们能够在开始解决问题之前消化大量文档。

Drop a coding agent into any existing codebase that uses libraries and tools that are too private or too new to feature in the training data and my experience is that it works just fine - the agent will consult enough of the existing examples to understand patterns, then iterate and test its own output to fill in the gaps.

将一个编程智能体投入到任何现有代码库中——即使其中使用的库和工具过于私有或太新而未曾出现在训练数据中——我的经验是，它工作得相当出色：智能体会查阅足够多的现有示例来理解模式，然后迭代并测试其输出以填补空白。

This is a surprising result. I thought coding agents would prove to be the ultimate embodiment of the Choose Boring Technology approach, but in practice they don't seem to be affecting my technology choices in that way at all.

这是一个令人惊讶的结果。我曾以为编程智能体会成为Choose Boring Technology（选择乏味技术）理念的终极体现，但在实践中，它们似乎完全没有以那种方式影响我的技术选择。

Update: A few follow-on thoughts:

更新：几点后续思考：

  • The issue of what technology LLMs recommend is a separate one. What Claude Code Actually Chooses is an interesting recent study where Edwin Ong and Alex Vikati where they proved Claude Code over 2,000 times and found a strong bias towards build-over-buy but also identified a preferred technical stack, with GitHub Actions, Stripe, and shadcn/ui seeing a "near monopoly" in their respective categories. For the sake of this post my interest is in what happens when the human makes a technology choice that differs from those preferred by the model harness.

• LLMs推荐何种技术是一个独立的问题。《What Claude Code Actually Chooses》是Edwin Ong和Alex Vikati最近进行的一项有趣研究，他们对Claude Code进行了超过2,000次验证，发现其强烈倾向于"自建而非购买"（build-over-buy），但也识别出了一个偏好的技术栈，其中GitHub Actions、Stripe和shadcn/ui在各自类别中呈现出"近乎垄断"的地位。就本文而言，我关注的是当人类做出与模型框架偏好不同的技术选择时会发生什么。

  • The Skills mechanism that is being rapidly embraced by most coding agent tools is super-relevant here. We are already seeing projects release official skills to help agents use them - here are examples from Remotion, Supabase, Vercel, and Prisma.

• Skills（技能）机制正被大多数编程智能体工具快速采用，这与本文高度相关。我们已经看到许多项目发布官方技能来帮助智能体使用它们——以下是来自Remotion、Supabase、Vercel和Prisma的示例。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 零数据复现生产查询计划
item.description:
标签: #数据库 #查询优化 #统计信息

摘要: 本文介绍PostgreSQL和SQLite的新功能：通过导入体积极小的统计信息（通常不足1MB）而非海量生产数据，开发者可在开发环境中精确复现生产查询计划，便于调试和优化。

原标题: Production query plans without production data

Production query plans without production data

The PostgreSQL query planner makes use of internal statistics to help it decide how to best execute a query. These statistics often differ between production data and development environments, which means the query plans used in production may not be replicable in development.

PostgreSQL 的查询计划器（query planner）利用内部统计信息（statistics）来帮助决定如何最佳地执行查询。这些统计信息在生产数据（production data）和开发环境（development environments）之间往往存在差异，这意味着生产环境中使用的查询计划可能无法在开发环境中复现。

PostgreSQL's new features now let you copy those statistics down to your development environment, allowing you to simulate the plans for production workloads without needing to copy in all of that data first.

PostgreSQL 的新特性现在允许你将这些统计信息复制到开发环境中，让你能够模拟生产工作负载的查询计划，而无需首先复制所有这些数据。

I found this illustrative example useful:

我发现这个说明性的示例很有用：

SELECT pg_restore_attribute_stats(
    'schemaname', 'public',
    'relname', 'test_orders',
    'attname', 'status',
    'inherited', false::boolean,
    'null_frac', 0.0::real,
    'avg_width', 9::integer,
    'n_distinct', 5::real,
    'most_common_vals', '{delivered,shipped,cancelled,pending,returned}'::text,
    'most_common_freqs', '{0.95,0.015,0.015,0.015,0.005}'::real[]
);

（代码示例：使用 pg_restore_attribute_stats 函数恢复属性统计信息）

This simulates statistics for a status column that is 95% delivered. Based on these statistics PostgreSQL can decide to use an index for status = 'shipped' but to instead perform a full table scan for status = 'delivered'.

这模拟了一个 status 列的统计信息，其中 95% 的值是 delivered。基于这些统计信息，PostgreSQL 可以决定对 status = 'shipped' 使用索引，而对 status = 'delivered' 则执行全表扫描（full table scan）。

These statistics are pretty small. Radim says:

这些统计信息非常小。Radim 表示：

Statistics dumps are tiny. A database with hundreds of tables and thousands of columns produces a statistics dump under 1MB. The production data might be hundreds of GB. The statistics that describe it fit in a text file.

统计信息转储非常小。一个包含数百张表和数千列的数据库产生的统计信息转储不到 1MB。生产数据可能有数百 GB，而描述它的统计信息却能放入一个文本文件中。

Statistics dumps are tiny. A database with hundreds of tables and thousands of columns produces a statistics dump under 1MB. The production data might be hundreds of GB. The statistics that describe it fit in a text file.

统计信息转储非常小。一个包含数百张表和数千列的数据库产生的统计信息转储不到 1MB。生产数据可能有数百 GB，而描述它的统计信息却能放入一个文本文件中。

I posted on the SQLite user forum asking if SQLite could offer a similar feature and D. Richard Hipp promptly replied that it has one already:

我在 SQLite 用户论坛上发帖询问 SQLite 是否能提供类似功能，D. Richard Hipp 迅速回复称它已经有了：

All of the data statistics used by the query planner in SQLite are available in the sqlite_stat1 table (or also in the sqlite_stat4 table if you happen to have compiled with SQLITE_ENABLE_STAT4). That table is writable. You can inject whatever alternative statistics you like.This approach to controlling the query planner is mentioned in the documentation:https://sqlite.org/optoverview.html#manual_control_of_query_plans_using_sqlite_stat_tables.See alsohttps://sqlite.org/lang_analyze.html#fixed_results_of_analyze.The ".fullschema" command in the CLI outputs both the schema and the content of the sqlite_statN tables, exactly for the reasons outlined above - so that we can reproduce query problems for testing without have to load multi-terabyte database files.

SQLite 查询计划器使用的所有数据统计信息都可以在 sqlite_stat1 表中找到（如果你使用 SQLITE_ENABLE_STAT4 编译，也可以在 sqlite_stat4 表中找到）。该表是可写的。你可以注入任何你想要的替代统计信息。这种控制查询计划器的方法在文档中有提及：https://sqlite.org/optoverview.html#manual_control_of_query_plans_using_sqlite_stat_tables。另请参阅 https://sqlite.org/lang_analyze.html#fixed_results_of_analyze。CLI 中的 .fullschema 命令会输出模式（schema）和 sqlite_statN 表的内容，正是出于上述原因——这样我们就可以在测试中重现查询问题，而无需加载多 TB 的数据库文件。

All of the data statistics used by the query planner in SQLite are available in the sqlite_stat1 table (or also in the sqlite_stat4 table if you happen to have compiled with SQLITE_ENABLE_STAT4). That table is writable. You can inject whatever alternative statistics you like.

SQLite 查询计划器使用的所有数据统计信息都可以在 sqlite_stat1 表中找到（如果你使用 SQLITE_ENABLE_STAT4 编译，也可以在 sqlite_stat4 表中找到）。该表是可写的。你可以注入任何你想要的替代统计信息。

This approach to controlling the query planner is mentioned in the documentation:https://sqlite.org/optoverview.html#manual_control_of_query_plans_using_sqlite_stat_tables.

这种控制查询计划器的方法在文档中有提及：https://sqlite.org/optoverview.html#manual_control_of_query_plans_using_sqlite_stat_tables。

See alsohttps://sqlite.org/lang_analyze.html#fixed_results_of_analyze.

另请参阅 https://sqlite.org/lang_analyze.html#fixed_results_of_analyze。

The ".fullschema" command in the CLI outputs both the schema and the content of the sqlite_statN tables, exactly for the reasons outlined above - so that we can reproduce query problems for testing without have to load multi-terabyte database files.

CLI 中的 .fullschema 命令会输出模式（schema）和 sqlite_statN 表的内容，正是出于上述原因——这样我们就可以在测试中重现查询问题，而无需加载多 TB 的数据库文件。
